[[Bob Cousy Award]] }} '''Darryl Jerard ("D.J.") Augustin, Jr.''' (born [[November 10]] [[1987]] in [[New Orleans, Louisiana|New Orleans]], [[Louisiana]]) is an [[United States|American]] [[college basketball]] player who was formerly the [[point guard]] for the [[University of Texas at Austin|University of Texas]] [[Texas Longhorns|Longhorns]]. Augustin has entered the 2008 NBA Draft, and is projected as a first-round lottery pick. ==Playing career== ===High school=== Augustin's family was forced out of New Orleans by [[Hurricane Katrina]]. He played his senior (final) year at [[Hightower High School]] in [[Missouri City, Texas]]. However, he got his diploma from [[Brother Martin High School]] in New Orleans, and he participated in the graduation ceremonies with his Hightower classmates on May 28, 2006 at Houston's [[Toyota Center]]. While at Brother Martin, Augustin led the team to two state championships. While at Hightower, DJ showed why he was one of the top players in the nation, and thrilled the Hightower faithful with his pinpoint passing and precise shooting. His first game as a Hurricane was vs Madison High school, and DJ nearly pulled off a triple double in front of a packed house and tv camera's with 29 points, 8 rebounds and 14 assists in a 83-59 victory. DJ led Hightower to the third round of the playoffs before they were eliminated, and ended the season at 26-4. DJ won numerous honors after the season as he was named district 20-5A MVP, was named as the Houston Chronicle player of the year, made the first team all Greater Houston, and first team all state teams. DJ finished his high school career by being named a McDonalds All American, and started as point guard for the west squad against his soon to be teamate at Texas, game MVP from the east's [[Kevin Durant]].{{cite news | publisher=[[USA Today]] | title=Highly regarded New Orleans prep guard lands in Texas | last=Lawlor | first=Christopher | url=http://www.usatoday.com/sports/preps/2005-09-14-notes_x.htm | date=[[2005-02-14]] | accessdate=2207-12-15}} ===University of Texas=== ====Freshman year==== Augustin was one of seven freshman to join the Longhorn basketball program for the 2006-07 season. He started all 35 games in the season as the point guard for the Longhorns, averaging 14.4 points and 6.7 assists per game. For his contributions, he was named to both the All-Big 12 Second Team and the Big 12 All-Rookie Team by the coaches and [[Associated Press]].{{cite news | publisher=[[Texas Longhorns|University of Texas Athletics]] | title=Durant tabbed Big 12 Conference Player and Freshman of the Year | url=http://www.texassports.com/index.php?s=&url_channel_id=16&url_article_id=6020&url_subchannel_id=&change_well_id=2 | date=[[2007-03-04]] | accessdate=2007-12-15}} [[Kevin Durant]] (former Teammate) was quoted as saying " I don't think I would be where I am today without D.J. (Augustin)". Also, the Texas Longhorns play-by-play analyst stated " Man, Augustin makes everyone who he plays around better". ====Sophomore year==== Augustin, along with [[Texas A&M Aggies basketball|Texas A&M Aggies]] player [[Joseph Jones (basketball player)|Joseph Jones]], was featured on the front cover of the [[November 15]], [[2007]] issue of ''[[Sports Illustrated]]''.{{cite press release|url=http://www.aggieathletics.com/pressRelease.php?SID=MBB&PRID=13617|title=Jones, Aggies Featured On SI Cover|publisher=Texas A&M Athletics|accessdate=2007-11-17|date=2007-11-15}} In the fall 2007 semester, he achieved a 4.0 [[Grade point average|GPA]], raising his cumulative GPA to a 3.64.[http://www.texassports.com/index.php?s=&url_channel_id=16&url_article_id=8139&url_subchannel_id=&change_well_id=2 TexasSports.com - Augustin named to ESPN The Magazine Academic All-District 6 First Team] On [[February 27]], [[2008]], he was named first-team Academic All-America by the College Sports Information Directors of America. He became the second Texas Longhorn basketball player to achieve the honor, following Jim Krivacs, who received it in 1979.{{cite news|url=http://www.statesman.com/sports/content/sports/stories/longhorns/02/27//0227texmen.html|title=Augustin named Academic All-American.|publisher=''Austin American-Statesman''|accessdate=2008-02-28}} Augustin was also named to the USBWA All-America First Team. On [[April 3]], [[2008]], the [[Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame]] awarded him the [[Bob Cousy Award]].[http://www.big12sports.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/040308aab.html A Big 12 Point Guard Wins Cousy Award For Second Straight Season :: ] On [[April 23]], [[2008]], Augustin declared himself eligible for the NBA Draft.[http://www.dallasnews.com/sharedcontent/dws/spt/stories/042408dnspouthoops.2dd7b85.html Texas' Augustin, Abrams entering NBA draft] On [[June 3]], [[2008]], Augustin hired an agent thereby forfeiting his remaining NCAA eligibility.[http://www.statesman.com/sports/content/sports/stories/longhorns/06/03/0603texmen.html Augustin hires agent] ====NBA==== Augustin had a chance to participate in the [[2007 NBA Draft]] with former teammate [[Kevin Durant]], but he chose to stay in school to develop his game more with the Longhorns. Augustin is in the [[NBA Draft|2008 NBA Draft]] which takes place on June 26th, 2008. ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[http://www.texassports.com/index.php?s=&url_channel_id=16&change_well_id=17&member_id=973 Profile at TexasSports.com] {{1980s-US-hoops-bio-stub}} {{UTexas-stub}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Augustin, D.
